summary: The service module controls services across init systems (systemd, SysV, OpenRC, upstart, BSD, SMF) by proxying to the detected service manager module. It doesn't use the service CLI, and Windows needs win_service.
questions: How do I start or stop a service on any Linux distro?
Which init systems does the service module support?
Does ansible service call the 'service' command?
How do I manage Windows services?

answer_card.title: Manage services generically
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.service` proxies to the detected service manager module (`systemd`, `sysvinit`, OpenRC, upstart, BSD init, SMF). Only common arguments are guaranteed. It doesn't rely on the `service` CLI. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_service`. AIX group subsystem names work.
